scope: Discriminatory strength of the focal P1342 R2 composite contract/oracle only. No future candidate, implementation acceptance, lifecycle/profile, NT01-NT06 or terminal-policy claim.

harness.method: Replay A01-A21 through the unchanged composite judge, then apply 22 minimal boundary mutations to deep copies of the inspectable composite. Evidence hash is recomputed only for attacks whose malformed but authenticated envelope is itself under test; the explicit out-of-band mismatch control keeps the original trusted hash.

r1_replay_matrix.result: R2 closes every previously published R1 adversarial vector

r2_boundary_matrix.witness: evidence closed keys reject unknown member
H12A runtime coverage tail replaced by unrelated all-zero digest
H00D runtime coverage tail replaced by unrelated all-f digest
issuer receipt reference replaced by all-zero digest

blockers.finding: runtime hook_hits receipt_tail is checked only for null-versus-64-hex shape. It is never compared to an append_receipt receipt for the same origin/hook, so arbitrary coverage tails for H12A and H00D are accepted. H00/H04/H06/H08/H09/H10 have runtime receipt claims but no corresponding raw event receipt at all.
blockers.reproduction: Run the harness; X05 and X06 return Preserved in every batch.

blockers.finding: challenge_issuer_receipt_sha256 is accepted as any 64 lowercase hex string and is not resolved against a supplied canonical receipt or external expected hash. Authenticating the evidence envelope does not validate the referenced issuer receipt.
blockers.reproduction: All three issuer receipt hashes are replaced by 64 zeroes; X09 remains Preserved.

blockers.finding: Receipt integrity proves the order that was serialized, but cell_semantics checks causal order only from walk through replay-exit. Swapping context-dispatch and dict-prebound, then canonically rebuilding the raw receipt chain and projection, remains Preserved even though the frozen contract requires the base causal order.
blockers.reproduction: X11 swaps the two events and recomputes every dependent digest; it returns Preserved.

blockers.finding: The callback_with and func_callback endpoints recorded at counter-occurrence-created are never equated with the later dispatch/With/body endpoints. run and ledger refs are domain-checked but not required to remain equal across an origin cell. Each disconnected in-domain endpoint survives as Preserved.
blockers.reproduction: Run X15-X18; all return Preserved while the raw chain, projection and evidence digests remain internally valid.

blockers.finding: Because the created inner Func endpoint is not checked against the With/body chain, making the witness opaque after disconnecting that endpoint returns Unknown rather than Violated. A non-payload identity failure therefore still occurs before the allowed opacity boundary.
blockers.reproduction: X22 returns Unknown in normal, repeat and reverse.

stop_decision: Nine valid negatives survived. Score is below 1.0, so the composite R2 cannot be sealed. This adversary does not correct the judged artifacts.
